## Projects {#projects}

Selected projects featured on my resume.

### VoxHire — AI Voice Interviewer

A browser based AI interviewer that conducts adaptive technical interviews, asks follow-up questions, evaluates answers, and produces a performance report.

**Built with:** JavaScript, Node.js, AssemblyAI Voice Agent API, WebSockets, Render

[Live demo](https://voice-agent-r3fb.onrender.com) · [Source code](https://github.com/swaroop-khan/Voxhire)

### Telecom Customer Churn Prediction

An end to end machine learning project for predicting telecom customer churn, with preprocessing, class imbalance handling, Optuna tuning, and a Streamlit prediction app.

**Built with:** Python, scikit-learn, SMOTE, Optuna, Streamlit, Pandas

[Source code](https://github.com/swaroop-khan/telecom-customer-churn-prediction)

### House Price Prediction

A Kaggle regression project using preprocessing, feature engineering, and Gradient Boosting to predict residential sale prices.

**Built with:** Python, Pandas, Gradient Boosting

[Source code](https://github.com/swaroop-khan/house-price-prediction)

### Titanic Survival Prediction

An end to end classification project with feature engineering, model comparison, hyperparameter tuning, and cross validation to predict passenger survival.

**Built with:** Python, scikit-learn

[Source code](https://github.com/swaroop-khan/titanic-survival-ml)
